text: Margaret Hamilton led the software engineering division at MIT Draper Laboratory. She and her team developed the onboard flight software for the Apollo program. Hamilton coined the term "software engineering" while working on the Apollo guidance system. She received the Presidential Medal of Freedom from President Barack Obama in 2016 for her contributions to the field.
